title: Locally Linear Generalized Single Index Regression
abstract: arXiv:2611.22011v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this work we propose and analyze a procedure for estimating a generalized single-index regression model. This generalized single-index regression framework models the conditional mean of the responses $Y$ as a function of the covariates $X$ where the mapping is assumed to have the form $f \circ g$, where $g$ is $\beta$-H\"older with $\beta \geq 2$ and $f$ can be a discontinuous function of bounded variation. We propose a general procedure that operates under minimal assumptions about the distribution of covariates $X$, requiring only boundedness, sufficient smoothness and absolute continuity with respect to Lebesgue. Our procedure jointly estimates the gradient vector $\hat v(x) \approx \nabla g(x)$ and the conditional mean $\mu(x) = f(g(x))$ by solving a localized weighted linear least squares problem. translated_title: 局部线性广义单指标回归
translated_abstract: 在本工作中，我们提出并分析了用于估计广义单指标回归模型的一种方法。该广义单指标回归框架将响应变量 $Y$ 的条件均值建模为协变量 $X$ 的函数，其中映射被假设具有 $f \circ g$ 的形式，其中 $g$ 是 $\beta \geq 2$ 的 $\beta$-Hölder 函数，而 $f$ 可以是一个有界变差的不连续函数。我们提出了一种通用方法，该方法在关于协变量 $X$ 分布的极小假设下运行，只要求有界性、足够的平滑性以及关于勒贝格测度的绝对连续性。我们的方法通过求解局部加权线性最小二乘问题，联合估计梯度向量 $\hat v(x) \approx \nabla g(x)$ 和条件均值 $\mu(x) = f(g(x))$。我们推导了梯度向量估计 $\hat{v}_x$ 和回归估计 $\hat{\mu}(x)$ 的中心极限定理，并进一步推导了 r（摘要内容在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出了一种在对协变量分布要求极低的假设下估计广义单指标回归模型的局部加权线性最小二乘方法，能够联合估计梯度向量和条件均值（即使链接函数不连续），并为其建立了中心极限定理。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a locally weighted linear least squares procedure for estimating generalized single-index regression models under minimal distributional assumptions on covariates, jointly estimating the gradient vector and conditional mean—even with a discontinuous link function—and establishing central limit theorems for both estimates.
